params.name: Real street names
params.tooltip: New Road Stops in known cities get real street names.

params.name: Real station names
params.tooltip: New train stations, bus/tram stations, airports and harbours in known cities get real names.

params.name: Debug: performance log
params.tooltip: Off: normal play. On: every 30 s, this mod writes how long its name lists and station renaming took to the game's log file (stdout.txt, lines starting with [SQPERF]), plus one line per renamed stop or station. Only for tracking down slowdowns; leave it Off otherwise. Slow calls are always logged briefly, whatever this setting.
